method: Renamed a ZZ probe task to 'ZZ probe rename tomorrow' and saved, in one uninterrupted script per app so the poll's t=0 lines up exactly with the Save click. Polled roughly every 450ms for about 11.5s recording toast presence/text/Undo. In a second, clean attempt (date cleared back to none first, so Undo's effect would be visible), clicked Undo immediately once the toast appeared and read the task's resulting date and title.

toastPoll.verdict: MATCH -- verbatim identical toast text 'Date updated to Tomorrow' with an Undo action in both apps, present for essentially the same ~10s window in this same session (Todoist 129-10160ms, meologue 108-10161ms). This is the flow-4 defect (#15, 'no toast when a rename sets a date') and it is now fixed: meologue previously showed no toast at all across 24 polls over 11.6s.

undoTest.method: Cleared the task's date to none first (so Undo's effect is unambiguous, unlike an earlier attempt in this same run where the date was already 'Tomorrow' from a prior save and Undo appeared to do nothing -- a testing artifact, not a product finding, corrected by this clean re-test), then renamed with 'tomorrow' again, saved, and clicked Undo as soon as the toast's button appeared.

meologue.dateAfterUndo: (none -- Date control shows no value, row date badge gone)

undoTest.verdict: MATCH -- in both apps, clicking Undo reverts the date to none while leaving the NLP-stripped title ('ZZ probe rename', without the word 'tomorrow') as-is. Neither app restores the literal typed text.

methodNote: The toast's Undo button sits partly below the 836px-tall viewport's bottom edge in both apps (button bottom rect ~22-23px past innerHeight regardless of viewport height tested, in Todoist). A click at the button's geometric center misses because that center falls outside the clickable viewport; a real page.mouse.click at the button's TOP edge (rect.top + 2px, confirmed on-target via document.elementFromPoint before every click) lands on the button reliably in both apps.

overallVerdict.note: Both the toast (text, Undo presence, ~10s lifetime) and the Undo action's effect (date cleared, NLP-stripped title kept) now match Todoist exactly.
